_comment: Remote MCP servers shared over the agent bus (see src/mcp.ts and README 'Remote MCP'). Deploy to the router state dir (or point MCP_REGISTRY at this file). Git is the reviewed source of truth; the router loads it at start. class must be 'read-only' or 'side-effecting'; side-effecting calls additionally need a Mick-issued grant ID (bin/agent-bus-grant) and are otherwise hard-rejected. env values may be literals or 'file:/abs/path' resolved on the hosting node at spawn time, so secrets never transit the bus. Address hosts by their stable node name, never by tailnet IP.

servers.name: inventory
servers.description: Read-only infra inventory (generated, secret-free export of aikeys assets — no credentials)

servers.name: web-tools
servers.description: z.ai web search + reader for clients without built-in search (key stays on the hosting node)
